description: Short temporary messages in a corner of the screen (toasts), such as "Tiket ditambahkan ke keranjang". They disappear after a few seconds.
setup: Place <Toaster /> once near the root of your app:
call: Then call toast() from anywhere. Always import toast from @mestakara/ui/sonner (not from "sonner" directly) so it talks to the same Toaster.

types.title: Types
types.description: toast.success, toast.info, toast.warning and toast.error use the status colors.

promise.title: Running Process
promise.description: toast.promise shows a loading state, then success or failure.

props.richColors: Background color per type (success green, error red, …).
props.toast: Shows a toast. Options: description, action, duration and more.
